caption:
Canva just released Canva Craft, the first image model it built and trained itself, and it is open to all Canva users in Dream Lab.
Canva says it plans the layout before it draws, so text and details come out cleaner.
You can change one part of an image and turn the result into editable layers.

Would you make your next post with Canva's own AI?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

Source: Unite.AI · Photo: Canva
threads_text: Canva built its own AI image model, Canva Craft, and every Canva user can try it now in Dream Lab. It plans the layout first and was trained on Canva templates, so posters and menus with real text are the point. Would you drop your current image generator for it?

slides.headline: Canva just built its own AI image model. Here's how to try *Canva Craft*

slides.heading: 1. Open *Dream Lab*
paras: Craft is available to all Canva users. Open Dream Lab from the panel at the bottom left of Canva.
Canva built and trained the model itself, with help from the Leonardo.ai team it bought in 2024.

slides.heading: 2. Describe the *whole layout*
paras: Craft plans the scene first: what goes where, how big, and what the text says. Then it draws. Say all of that in your prompt.
Pick one of about 30 aspect ratios, or set your own.
slides.prompt: A bold poster for a summer street food festival. Big title at the top that says "Night Market", three food stalls under string lights, date in small text at the bottom.

slides.heading: 3. Put *real words* in it
paras: Craft was trained on Canva templates like posters, menus and infographics, and it can write text in 55 languages.
Spell out every word you want on the image.
slides.prompt: A clean cafe menu board with the heading "Today's Coffee" and four items with prices: Latte $4, Cold Brew $5, Mocha $5, Espresso $3.

slides.heading: 4. Fix *one part only*
paras: Canva says Craft can change one element and leave the rest of the image alone.
When it looks right, turn the image into editable layers and finish it like any Canva design.
slides.prompt: Keep everything the same, but change the string lights to warm orange lanterns.

slides.hook: Save this for your next poster, and follow to hear when Craft comes to ChatGPT and Gemini.
